scenarios.name: a key combo is pressed in order and released in reverse, as one step
a combo leaves a modifier the phone holds held
control lost mid-combo presses nothing more, and what it pressed is released
a combo whose desktop changes mid-way sends nothing to the new one: its presses are dropped
a cancel during a combo still releases what it pressed
releaseAll lifts every held press once and is idempotent
an up for a press this backend does not own is skipped
a button up without a position lifts the button pressed at one
a backend switch releases the old backend’s presses through it, before the switch
a press its backend can’t release at the switch is dropped and counted, never carried
cancel drops queued input but the final release runs after the in-flight command
the gate is re-read between the commands of one plan
text is refused while a shortcut modifier is held, allowed with Shift
AltGr text: the session-held AltGr keys are lifted around the text and pressed again
Right Alt alone counts as AltGr
Ctrl+Left Alt stays a shortcut: its text is refused and sends nothing
AltGr with the Windows key stays a shortcut
AltGr keys are pressed again even when the text itself fails
abandon cuts an in-flight send and every later one; the releases are dropped and counted
a cancel during the AltGr lift: no text, no re-press, nothing left held
the backend moves to another session during the AltGr lift: no further lift, text or re-press there
a revoke after the text, before the re-press: AltGr is never pressed again
a revoke before the text: the lifted keys stay up and the text is not sent
no key-up reaches another session: it is dropped, not sent later
no key-up reaches another desktop: it is dropped, not sent later
each origin’s press of the same key is released only on its own desktop
no press is made where the landing desktop is unknown
abandon also cuts a switch hook that never settles
a failing switch hook does not stop the switch
a switch to no backend releases first, then input is rejected
input before any backend is chosen is rejected
the desktop’s presses are lifted through it when the secure desktop takes over, and the secure backend gets only its own
a plan that fails on the backend is rejected and keeps the press it made held for the release
